title: After Massage
summary: After finishing, sit or lie quietly and assess how you feel before getting up.
goal: End the session safely and notice any unusual response.
startingPosition: Intensity has already been reduced and the person is stable.
instructions: Allow 1–2 minutes of quiet sitting or lying.
direction: This is the finishing stage rather than a movement technique.
tips: Uncertainty is enough reason to reduce intensity or postpone massage.
Safety takes priority over completing a plan.
mistakes: Trying to continue at any cost.
Making overly confident conclusions without professional assessment.
warning: This guide is educational and does not replace medical diagnosis or individualized professional advice.
